notes: The search for the year: PD43+ dates every 2022 question 2022-08-11, the statewide November questions included, so the date cannot pick them out.

The Secretary of the Commonwealth's certified returns ('all from Public Document 43'). The search page gives every contest's certified contest-wide figures (stored as its totals); each contest's CSV files give its cities, towns and precincts.
gaps: County commissioners, Barnstable County's Assembly of Delegates, the Martha's Vineyard Commission and regional school district committees

elected on the same ballot, but the Secretary's results database (PD43+) has no office for them and the Governor and Council's certificate does not list them; their returns are each city and town clerk's
